Record Class GraphSettings

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
com.mobybank.harness.infrastructure.graph.GraphSettings
Record Components:
baseUrl - Graph root, such as https://graph.microsoft.com/v1.0
drive - which drive: me/drive (signed-in user), users/<upn>/drive or drives/<id>; app-only tokens cannot use me/drive
foldersRoot - folder path whose sub-folders form the library; empty means the drive root
accessToken - a ready-made bearer token (for quick demos); otherwise client credentials are used
tokenUrl - the OAuth token endpoint for client credentials
clientId - the Entra app registration's client id
clientSecret - its client secret (supply it from the environment, never commit it)
requestTimeout - how long any one HTTP request may take
maxDownloadBytes - the largest file the harness will download
public record GraphSettings(String baseUrl, String drive, Optional<String> foldersRoot, Optional<String> accessToken, String tokenUrl, Optional<String> clientId, Optional<String> clientSecret, Duration requestTimeout, long maxDownloadBytes) extends Record
Settings for the OneDrive catalog.

      public final boolean equals(Object o)
      Indicates whether some other object is "equal to" this one. The objects are equal if the other object is of the same class and if all the record components are equal.
